correctness.rationale: C PASS: The nondegenerate affine-parametric 3D nilpotent-Jacobian family is polynomially conjugate to G0(u,v,w)=(v-w,w,(v-w)^2), and each periodic state corresponds bijectively to a point of F(a,b)=(b,a^2-b^2). Independently reconstructed F^5-id and its exact lexicographic rational Groebner basis: a-R(b) with a degree-15 rational polynomial and second eliminant b*Q15(b)/1215. Squarefree degree-16 eliminant gives 16 simple complex fifth-fixed points, one fixed and 15 primitive period-5 points (three complex 5-cycles). An independent exact Sturm count found 5 nonzero real roots and the origin, so exactly one real primitive 5-cycle; complex conjugation exchanges the other two. Independent fifth-return 2x2 Jacobian calculation at the isolated positive root yielded trace ~-224.877075, determinant ~-162.975847 and eigenvalues ~0.722412,-225.599488; rational interval bounds in inspected CHECK.py certify positive eigenvalue in (0,1), negative below -1, with extra exact zero 3D eigenvalue. The finite symbolic elimination is exhaustive due its ideal/squarefree proof, not a floating-point search.

The earlier period-four threshold result concerns a different return length. The inspected prior primary text does not establish the full sixteen complex points, exactly one real five-cycle, or its hyperbolic saddle multipliers. The expanded 2024 journal version of the same 2022 paper was not individually inspected and remains a material historical-coverage risk; no claim of absolute global priority is made.
